Gift for my best friend. It is a very lovely gift it comes in great condition but mine came and it was missing a piece do not feel like dealing with sending it back just going to run out to the store and buy the piece that it was missing to give to my friend don’t have the time to wait for the return😞

Disappointed. We put the tree in the bag and tried to put it away but the handles started ripping and where the wheels connect to the bag ripped as well. We had to get the dolly. Bag is not durable at all. Would not recommend.

Not what I was looking for. Too long; slips on my leather chair, even with slip-guard sheets; looks shabby. On the other hand, I have donated them to a local charity, maybe they can sell them for a little cash.

Cut nothing. Totally disappointed in this product. Look good, feel good in the hand, but utterly fail when it comes to cutting. Won't even cut plastic bag on frozen vegetables. Don't cut paper. Sorry.

Sturdy desk but assembly of many parts takes over 2 hours & measurements are wrong. My boyfriend purchased this table for his 27" iMac. I had recommended he purchase a collapsible sewing table instead but he decided on this and regretted it. First of all, it comes in many parts. He tried for three days to assemble this and only got the frame for the side shelves together. I decided to see if I could put this together and it took me over two hours to get the remaining pieces together.

To my boyfriend the instructions were terrible. To me who puts a lot of items together, I found them satisfactory but lacking in certain details. For instance, it never says to install the second bracket or tells the user to face the top small table piece a certain way so that it is flush with the frame. I actually had to remove the top black piece I installed because when it is screwed in one way, the larger desk piece has holes that do not line up. Once I uninstalled the top black piece and then turned it in the other direction, it fit fine. Also, it is important to ensure that the holes in all of the bars are facing as pictured in the diagram.

Once it was together, it looked great as can be seen in my finished photo. However, the measurements online say this is 40"D x 24"W x 30"H when in reality it is 23-3/4"D (front to back--meaning from where the users sits to the wall) x 39-1/2" W (side to side) x 29-1/2" H (bottom to top--meaning how tall it is). First of all they switched the diameter and width measurements on the Amazon site but secondly if we switch those numbers they are 1/2" less on the width and 1/4" less on the diameter assuming they meant to say 24"D x 40"W x 30"H.

In summary, once assembled, this unit is very sturdy and minimalistic and looks very nice. The assembly is long and some people will find that frustrating. The measurements are not as advertised. Also, one of the smaller black shelves had a mark on it from the factory. To me this is 3 stars at the current price of $84.99 plus tax. To my boyfriend, he rates this 2 stars. He was ready to send it back because he was unable to assemble it. Once it was assembled, he is happy with it but does not like that the measurements are slightly off.

Unique Ziplock bag organizer w/cutters to hang on a wall or put in a super large drawer but TRICKY. This is a unique six-compartment organizer with two compartments for a box of plastic wrap (or wax paper) and foil with a cutter each and four other compartments for different types of Ziplock bags (quart, gallon, sandwich, and snack). The labels for the bags are etched into the bamboo. There are also two cutter strips included and I installed them in their tracks. The cutting strips cut well as can be seen from my photo.

What is unique about this organizer is that it is expandable. The sides expand to allow me to put the boxes into the organizer instead of just the rolls of foil, plastic wrap, or wax paper. I did not have a box of foil or plastic wrap, so I took a photo with a box of bags in one of the compartments. I also tested the cutting strips with a piece of wax paper ( see photo) and they cut well.

The unit does not open so the bags have to be loaded through their holes.

This can be hung on the wall or be placed in a drawer that is large enough to hold it--the drawer must be very large. No rubberized circles are proved, which is a negative as that is needed to attach to the underside to keep this from sliding around or scratching a drawer or wall. Also, no screws with plastic mollies are provided for hanging, which is another disappointment. There are two holes if using this contracted and for the bags only or four holes if using fully expanded to expose the six compartments.

Overall, this is an excellent organizer that does away with all those squished and ugly boxes in my cabinets. It is definitely a quality unit and a very heavy one at that. However, the BIGGEST NEGATIVE is also its most unique feature. The expandable sections cannot be expanded on the wall. This means, one has to set the expansion distance before securing to the wall. It is also impossible to load and unload the boxes in the side panels when it is on the wall, simply because it cannot be expanded. If they cut a channel or groove where the screw goes, then I would be able to slide it open and closed at least a little bit. It is very possible this has to be removed from the wall every time a box needs to be loaded. Also, if the box size changes, that presents a problem when the distance is already set for a unit that was previously hung.

The current price of $31.99 ($39.99 minus 20%) is on the high side of competitively priced for this. There are many other Ziplock bag organizer options available on the market such as this [[ASIN:B09KMNHM2J one]] or this [[ASIN:B09VGP1WRL one]]. For one full unit only, then I recommend this [[ASIN:B09RF759BM rustic organizer]]. For a more modern look, I recommend this [[ASIN:B09WN5PZ6Q one]] or an individual heavy plastic set like [[ASIN:B09THNTBGX this]]. For a cheaper unit that has room for foil and plastic wrap, then I highly recommend this [[ASIN:B0B1TPD21S one]] but no screws are provided with that one. I tried all of these and the style purchased is based on what one desires. I personally like these other ones a little better than this one.

Functional Ziplock bag organizer but cheap quality; tricky to get the magnets to line up. At the current price of $14.99, the low quality is as expected. This is a functional plastic four-compartment organizer to store different types of Ziplock bags (quart, gallon, sandwich, and snack). The unit has holes tinier than most other organizers but since this is hinged, the door can be opened. There are two center magnets (one on the top and one on the bottom) that hold the door closed. The bottom magnet fell out on mine and I had to reseat it. However, they are not lined up well and, as a result, the door stays ajar (see photo) unless I move the door into a position that catches with the magnet. The labels are etched into the compartments.

It comes with plastic mounting "nipples" that supposedly stick to a wall. However, I do not feel this would be secure as it might be too heavy when loaded for the adhesive to hold. I would use screws with plastic mollies if I were hanging this. If putting this in a drawer, there are rubberized feet already affixed to the bottom to prevent scratches or prevent it from sliding around. In addition, a tiny 1.5" level is provided to ensure the unit is level on the wall when hanging.

Note that when this is on the wall, the bags can fall out when loading, so it is best to fill the unit through the holes.

Overall, this is a low-end organizer that does away with all those squished and ugly boxes in one's cabinets. It is definitely a low-end unit but is competitively priced for the quality.

There are many other Ziplock bag organizer options available on the market such as this [[ASIN:B09KMNHM2J one]] or this [[ASIN:B09VGP1WRL one]]. For one full unit only, then I recommend this [[ASIN:B09RF759BM rustic organizer]]. For a more modern look, I recommend this [[ASIN:B09WN5PZ6Q one]] or an individual heavy plastic set like [[ASIN:B09THNTBGX this]]. For a larger unit that has room for foil and plastic wrap, then I highly recommend this [[ASIN:B0B1TPD21S one]]. I tried all of these and the style purchased is based on what one desires. I personally like these other ones a little better than this one.

Overpriced reusable grocery bags but they do hold a lot. There are four large reusable bags in this set, each with one small side pocket and one small front pocket. They open into a flat bottom and hold a lot of stuff as shown in my photo. I was able to get a pound of pasta, a club-sized box of Club crackers, and a back pillow into one bag. However, at the current price of $17.59 ($21.99 minus 20%) these come to $4.40 per bag which is about $3.41 more than the $.99 cents larger and more festive bags that can be purchased at Home Goods, TJX, or Marshalls.

Basic but functional unlabeled Ziplock bag organizer for a drawer; pricey. This is a basic and unlabeled four-compartment Ziplock bag organizer with one opening each for different types of bags such as quart, gallon, sandwich, and snack bags. This cannot be hung on the wall unless someone drills holes through the unit. It is designed to be placed in a drawer that is large enough to hold it. There are NO rubberized circles provided to prevent this from slipping around in a drawer. The bags can only be loaded through the opening.

This is a super basic but functional organizer. It does away with all those squished and ugly boxes in my cabinets.

The current price of $29.89 is on the high competitively priced for this, especially since the compartments are not labeled, there are no hanging holes and screws with mollies provided, and no rubberized circles for the back. Other options that are available for organizers like this are this [[ASIN:B09D5Y63D1 one]] if one is looking for four separate compartments. For a variety of organizers (separate and one unit), then I recommend this [[ASIN:B09KMNHM2J one]] or this [[ASIN:B09VGP1WRL one]]. For one full unit only, then I recommend this [[ASIN:B09RF759BM rustic organizer]]. For a more modern look, I recommend this [[ASIN:B09WN5PZ6Q one]]. For a larger unit that has room for foil and plastic wrap, then I highly recommend this [[ASIN:B0B1TPD21S one]]. I tried all of these and the style purchased is based on what one desires.

Good as food scale only; app not ready for prime time. It comes with the scale, 4 AAA batteries (only 3 are needed), and a small setup manual that does not describe how to operate the app.

Based on my tests, I consider this a nice food scale that is only slightly quirky. It measures in grams, milliliter, milk volume when in milliliter, fluid ounces, and pounds and ounces. When using fluid ounces, it changes quickly to pounds and ounces unless I put something on the scale immediately. That is the quirky part.

I also downloaded the Android version of the Foodiet on my Samsung Galaxy Tab. I had to create an account and accept all the privacy and grant access to everything (photos, etc.) before I could continue. I then have to enter my sex, weight, and height and my goal weight. It has the ability to read package barcodes but what it read was garbage (see one photo where my package of nuts was labeled "Emmental" with totally wrong calories). I could also search for the foods and add them in as my breakfast, lunch, dinner, or snacks. I could also establish a meal plan. However, the app was usually non-responsive when I tried to navigate through it. It was not totally intuitive and did not always register the weight of items when I asked it to take the weight.

In summary, the app is useless to me and also requires a tremendous amount of time to set up. As a scale only, I would give this 4.5 stars. As a Smart scale, this gets 1 star, hence the 3-star rating. The current price of $29.99 is about $10 too much for this scale considering the app side does not work well.

Too ungainly long to be a washcloth; more like a scarf or table runner. This is not what I expected. There are two very, very long exfoliating washcloths in this package and a tiny silicone facial scrubber. The scrubber is good for the face but I cannot use these washcloths as intended. They are way too long and difficult to deal with. They can, however, be used as table runners or scarves with the exfoliating (colored) side facing up.

As washcloths, these get 2 stars and as scarves or table runners they get 4 stars--hence the 3-star rating.

Great idea but does not work well in practice; I’m sorry I ordered this. The idea behind this clip is to insert the cup like rim into a plastic bag and then wrap the bag around it and clip it closed. However, in practice this does not work well at all.

This separates into two parts. I followed the instructions as per the video but found that the clip is almost impossible to close once the bag is wrapped around it and I tried a thin biodegradable bag. Also, the flip top is almost impossible to snap shut. In addition, unless the bag has a very narrow top, the act of folding it causes the contents to be difficult to dispense because of all the creases in the bag.

I think this is a great idea but is just not functional in practice and is way too cumbersome to use. This is another item for the garbage. I am so sorry I purchased this, even though my purchase winds up being at a discount. I am so disappointed.

Easy to assemble but super flimsy and rips easily. There are 24 boxes in 4 designs with 8 of each design. Assembly is easy but there are no instructions. Unfortunately, the boxes are so flimsy that they do not even hold themselves up. They are not airtight. In addition, the locking mechanism broke immediately as can be seen in the photo. These are NOT worth the purchase in my opinion. They are somewhat usable but they will have to be taped around all the sides. The current price of $16.79 ($23.99 minus 30%) comes to $.70 cents per box.

Urn is the size of a thimble; will only hold a small fraction of ashes; inscription is too tiny. One would think this is a necklace with how small this urn is. This will only hold a thimbleful of ashes. The inscription on the front is microscopic and definitely not as clear as the Amazon site shows. It says "God has you in his arms I have you in my heart" and there is a heart image on either side of the word "heart."

In this package are three cleaning cloths, a plastic spoon to scoop in the ashes, a pouch for the urn, and the tiny thimble-sized urn. Also, the urn is not shiny and clear as pictured on Amazon. It is not great at all.

To me this is not worth the purchase.

Nice set; no heat rating on utensils; handles too thick for slots; FORC label is upside down on mat. This set comes with a mat that has an embedded spoon rest and slots for holding five utensils. There are also three utensils included--a locking silicone/stainless steel tong and regular and slotted spoons with silicone tips and wooden handles. The handles are a bit too thick to fit in the slots on the mat. Also, there is no heat rating written anywhere for the utensils; therefore, I have no idea if they will melt at certain temperatures. This is a big negative to me. I wrote them to find out the heat rating but have not heard back yet.

Second, the placement of the FORC label on the mat is upside down in the upper right corner--see PHOTO. This is sort of a non-issue but it is a detail that should be corrected.

The mat has a small lip around the edge that will keep water or liquids from running over the sides, which is great.

I love the color of this mat and its versatility. It is certainly very functional. It does come with a 12-month warranty and the label says this is 100% BPA free.

I have no idea how much this will be priced at but anything more than $12 in its current state would be overpriced in my opinion. They are selling similar sets at around $7 such as Amazon product ID #B08P7KD5XW, which is another one of their sets. If this set had handles that fit in the slots on the mat, had a label that was not upside down, and had a heat rating of 450 degrees or higher, then this would have received 5 stars from me.

May not be space saving & weight of clothes may break rod; assembly required. There are six colorful "space-saving" hangers in this package. Each one requires a slight assembly of the hook onto the hanging structure. Once installed, the hook can be slid around the hanger to either sit horizontally like a regular hanger or vertically.

For me, these are not space saving at all. Instead it drops the level of the clothing down to my next rod level, interfering with the bottom of my closet. In addition, there is now a bulk of clothes that hangs down a little further away from the closet rod. Even if it were space saving, the weight of the extra clothes may bring down the rod. There are nine holes on the hanger, which means there is room for nine garments, so each hanger gets very heavy.

Therefore, I would consider these more like closet organizers that do not save space but enable one to hang the clothes neater in the closet. After having tried these, I know they do not work for me.

The current price of $16.99 brings this to $2.83 per plastic hanger.

Low quality throw with bald patches. This red and black plaid throw is pretty and it feels velvety. It is thin like all other throws. Unfortunately, I am so sorry I ordered it as it is not worth what I will be paying for it.

This is a standard-sized throw but there are bald patches and lint throughout the entire throw as can be seen from the photos. I personally feel this is not worth more than $12 as the quality is substandard. I am sorry I believed the five star ratings of other reviewers at the time I decided to order this.

Sizing is all wrong and sham does not have a large enough lip to cover the pillow correctly. I am utterly disappointed in these pillowcases. First of all, I have a king-sized bed with king-sized pillows and some standard pillows. I ordered these in a king. However, the fit is a small standard and it is not even a good fit because the flap of the sham has too tiny a pocket to fit over the end of the pillow. Another negative is that these show and hold onto a lot of lint and cat hair.

Per my Internet search, these are the typical pillow sizes and the cases should be equivalent.

Standard Pillow Size 20" x 26"
Super Standard Pillow Size 20" x 28"
Queen Pillow Size 20" x 30"
King Pillow Size 20" x 36"

The box says these are King sized at 20" x 26" which is a full 10" shorter than needed. As can be seen in the photo, my king-sized pillow comes beyond the case. In the other photo, my standard pillow is even peeking out due to the cuff pocket being way too short.

The only thing good about these cases is the color and the feel. However, these are not functional due to the odd sizing and lack of correct pocket size for the end of the sham. The current price of $29.99 is outrageous for a substandard product. If it were perfect in sizing and sham pocket, then I would have rated this 5 stars and considered the price competitive.

Alternative comforter – YES but definitely not goose down; very soft. I was going to give this at least 4.5 stars because it is so soft, fluffy, comfortable, and vibrant. However, the Amazon site is very misleading as it says it is goose down, then in the next sentence it says it is alternative. This comforter has box squares stitched to keep the "cotton" in place. It feels like airy cotton inside the comforter. I personally love the way it looks, although I expected a better match with my purple bedroom. This "wine" color is really a fuchsia or hot pink than wine and the reverse side is a light pink. I like using this without a duvet. However, if I wanted to cover it, there are loops in all four corners and in the center to hold it in place inside a duvet.

It is lightweight and warm enough. I have not washed this yet and will not do that until after I used it for several months. I am unsure how this will hold up in the wash. I suspect the cotton in the squares will bunch up and have to be smooth out or may remain lumpy. It should be washed in cold water and hung to dry. It is made in India of 100% microfibre.

Overall, I really love the comfort of this comforter and one of my three cats would not get off the bed once I put this down--so it is cat approved as well.

Vacuum sealing w/o a machine BUT it takes a lot of stamina to remove the air & it’s not perfect. I have mixed feelings about this vacuum sealing option. On one hand I wish I had known about this before I purchased my Foodsaver Vacuum Sealer, but on the other hand, I am glad I have that machine even though it is quirky.

For the current price of $25.29, the following items are included in the box:
- 1 hand pump
- 10 extra large vacuum bags (11.8" x 13.4")
- 10 large vacuum bags (10.2" x 13.4")
- 10 medium vacuum bags (10.2" x 11")
- 4 sous vide holding clips (used to clip the bag to the side of the sous vide)
- 2 bag sealing clips (the white clips used to seal the zipper)

The only instructions are on the box. I inserted the food into the bag and pressed out most of the air by hand. I then used the white sealing clip to seal the zipper. I had to try this three times before I was successful. What I found is that it is best to place the bag flush with the counter and then press down hard on the white sealing clip as one slides it across the bag top.

Once the bag was sealed, I placed the pump over the "hole" to suck out the air. I also had trouble with this. I had to push down hard on the pump to create a suction with the "hole" in the bag that is not really a hole. Then it took immense effort to pump the pump up and down. I felt like I was inflating a bicycle tire manually. I really had trouble with the effort this took.

Once I was done, I removed the pump, clipped the bag to the sous vide, and started the cooking process. The bag floated a little bit after awhile. This means that air does seep back into the bag. However, I have had this with my machined sealed items as well. Lucky the clips keep the food submerged.

Cleaning out the bag is not easy. I know I had a hard time because I was unable to clean out the corners even when turning the bag inside out. I wound up throwing it out. I am skeptical of re-using them because they cannot be fully cleaned; especially with fish, meat, or something marinated. The Amazon site says each bag can be re-used more than 10 times; I seriously doubt that nor would I count on that. I would consider one use to be typical. For me, it has been one use only.

In summary, this is one option to try if a machine vacuum sealer is not available. I do think this is a viable option for those who use a sous vide intermittently. However, if someone uses a sous vide regularly, I would not recommend this due to the difficulty and price of replacement bags -- since washing them out is difficult to impossible.

Utterly disastrous poached eggs; this gets an F minus from me. I cannot believe I have to pay for this. This is not worth more than 50 cents.

This comes in three pieces. The yellow silicone cover on the handle, the frame itself with the egg well, and the silicone "bowl or rim."

After washing for first use, submerge this poacher in boiling water up to rim of poacher and pour egg from a prep bowl into the egg well once the water begins to swirl. Cook for 2-4 minutes, drain, and serve.

It seems easy (see first four photos for instructions) but it is not. First of all, when the water was ready, I poured the egg into the poacher and after a few seconds white foam (from the egg white) coagulated in the water. Once the egg was cooked, I gently lifted this from the pot. However, the yellow silicone handle kept sliding off so I had to keep re-attaching it. I finally squeezed it tightly while lifting the handle so it woud not fall off again. After the "egg well" drained as I lifted it from the pot, I turned over the poacher to release the egg.

Good luck. The egg is stuck relatively solid to the egg well. Only the yolk and top part of the egg white slipped out. I had to use a spoon to extricate the rest and it left some concrete residue behind.

I wanted to do another egg but the previous event clogged all the vents in the poacher. It took me a couple of hours of soaking the poacher in Dawn Platinium and scrubbing it for about 15 minutes to remove the "concrete" residue. Not only was this a tremendous amout of work but it was not easy to remove the silicone rim from the poacher for washing and re-assembling.

In summary, this is an absolutely awful poacher. It would be best to just crack the egg into boiling water with vinegar and then removing it with a slotted spoon. I am glad I used a non-stick pan or I would have been scrubbing that into the wee hours.

THE VERDICT - This gets an F minus. Use only if you want to spend hours extracting one poached egg and working on the cleanup.

Extremely functional but at this price, the tray should be flawless & without scratches. Come tax time my cost for this tray will wind up being less than the $50 advertised price. Had I paid the full $50, I would have been extremely disappointed. I am only somewhat disappointed since I paid less and I have no plans of gifting this.

The tray I received arrived with missing lacquer around the edges and scratches and other imperfections on the side. Although, this is noticeable, it does not take away from the serviceability of this piece. It remains highly functional, sturdy, and a great way to carry food items, coffee, tea, etc. to a porch, in bed, or wherever needed. A friend of mine uses a tray like this on her upholstered ottoman to serve tea on and protect her furniture.

Most of the finish on this tray is stunningly glossy. As can be seen from the first photo, you can see my reflection in the tray. Nevertheless, I expect the finish to be flawless. In its current state, the imperfections and scratches take away from its beauty and make it not giftable. This was packaged extremely well, so the issue stems from the manufacturing process. The $50 price combined with the lack of flawless finish is the reason I took off two stars; in every other way it is perfect.

More like an imperfect tapestry than a throw; hate the smell, texture, and design. I am very disappointed in this throw. First of all the texture is rough. Second, it smells like rubber. Third, the stitching has imperfections in it. Fourth, the design is not very pretty or western to me. Also, the texture reminds me a bit of sisal rope that my cats like to scratch. There is not one thing I like about this; I'm sorry I ordered it.

Dry cleaning is recommended but it can be machined washed on delicate as per the label.

Photo 1 shows the front; Photo 2 the back; Photo 3 the imperfections in back; and Photo 4 the imperfections in front.

I purchased three of these at TJX; they are super thin and tear easily; holds a lot. I purchased three (3) of these bags at TJX for $4.99 each plus tax (one in espresso color, another in grey, and one in dusty blue). They each are 24 in long x 18 in front to back x 12 in high.

The zipper extends around on both sides and there is a peek-a-boo window in front. There is also a handle on each side but I recommend it not be used.

The one I attached a picture of is in the espresso color. They hold a lot and because of that are heavy when moved. I was able to store one full shelf of shirts from my armoire in this one bag (about 40 tee shirts).

The problem with this bag is that it is made of a thin material that is like those free shopping bags supermarkets sell or different companies give out. Mine ripped immediately. It is just good for storage in place (without moving it).

Since I only paid $4.99 plus tax for each one, I feel it is okay for one time use as long as I gingerly carry it to its storage location or pack it at its exact storage location. However, this might rip the first moment used (as mine did by the handle). I would never pay $14.99 for this bag since it almost feels like tissue paper. I prefer thick plastic storage bags instead.

Very nice candle with a very sweet tropical citrus fragrance when burned. This has a nice citrus fragrance and is very attractive. Once burned, however, the tropical blend is a bit sweet, so it gave me a slight headache. If it burned as it smells when it is not burning, I would have rated this 4 stars.

On another note, mine arrived with a slightly bent container as you can see in the lower right-hand corner and I suspect that was because it was shipped in a padded envelope.

Looks and feels impressive but is not great for cooking with liquid ingredients such as eggs or pancakes. The Amazon title says this pan is small but that is not true. It is very large (11.25 inches) as you can see from the picture and extends beyond my large burner. I need a lot of room on the sides to prevent the handle from hanging over the stove.

I love the teal color and how wonderful the pan feels. It also appears to be very well made. It is sturdy but not overly heavy. The ridges on the inside are higher than I expected. As a result, this is best for frying bacon, making paninis, etc. with a [[ASIN:B005TGY0ME bacon press]] (not included).

OTHER LIKES
- It comes with a lifetime warranty.
- It oven safe up to 500 degrees Fahrenheit.

I used this to make scrambled eggs and because the ridges are large, the result was uneven and difficult as egg got stuck in the ridges. I own a [[ASIN:B01N5G52NJ Circulon 10868 11" Ultimum Forged Aluminum Nonstick Square Grill Pan, Large, Black]] that has ridges but the ridges are small and it works well with eggs and pancakes. This pan, on the other hand, is not as easy to work with when there are liquid ingredients.

CAVEATES
- It has a PTFE (Polytetrafluoroethylene) coating which is dangerous to birds and perhaps dangerous to food.
- This is NOT dishwasher safe.
- Due to the porcelain enamel exterior, there is the risk of this pan fusing to a ceramic or glass cooktop if overheated.
- The handle can get hot with extended cooking.

In summary, my first impressions of this pan were that this is awesome but once I put it to use and read the cardboard instructions, I am not so impressed. It works but there are better solutions available in my opinion.

I sent this back for a refund because the holes in the curved base were too small for the dowels provided. My boyfriend has a kneeling chair and I love it. I could not find the one he has so I decided to order this. Based on the look of the parts, the chair would probably have been a good one. However, the holes in the curved rocker part are too small to fit the dowels provided. I'm not interested in having to do woodworking to make the holes bigger so I returned this for a refund.

I probably would have liked or loved this chair otherwise. The instructions were pretty simple to me as I have assembled a lot of furniture before. In fact, I probably could have assembled it in 30 minutes. I already worked on it for 10 minutes when it came time to insert the dowels into the curved based. It was at that point I took it apart to send it back.

Nice towels but are small and get smaller after washing; definitely not luxury. These towels feel thick and mostly it's because of the tire-track design. They measure 19 inches x 16 inches before they are washed and they shrink to 17 inches x 16 inches after washing and drying. They dry my dishes well and are absorbent. I also like that there's no lint that is transferred to my dishes. I do not mind that they are small and overall I feel these are okay; however, they are definitely not luxury as specified and they do get smaller after the first washing and I probably would not buy them because of that.

To me luxury towels should be thick, plush, and not shrink.

A "no-frills" tea maker for brewing different teas at various temperatures but it is not comparable to the Breville One-Touch. I love everything tea and have purchased many brewing apparatuses. My favorite is the [[ASIN:B003LNOPSG Breville BTM800XL One-Touch Tea Maker]]. I love that tea maker so much that I purchased two of them at a cost of $500 because I cannot stand to be without a good tea brewer. (For those who are interested, I attached a link to my Breville review.)

This tea maker is a knock-off on that one. It is comparable in looks but in functionality it unfortunately falls a little short of my expectations.

PROS

- This tea maker is a very sleek looking unit.

- The infuser basket does not "leak" tea leaves due to the very fine mesh screening.

- The cord wraps into the base and has three slots from which to anchor it when unraveled. (NOTE: The cord is short at about 27 inches from exposed end to tip but that is typical of most appliances like this.)

- It is relatively easy to make tea or boil water with the push of a button as long as only the default steeping times are being used. There are buttons to boil water and for different type teas like white, green, black, etc.

- The unit comes with a tiny recipe pamphlet for different tea drinks.

CONS

- The white and green buttons should really be switched in my opinion. White tea is normally brewed at a lower temperature than green tea. Instead the green tea button brews at a lower temperature than white on this machine. I attached a link to a brewing chart in the comments section of this review.

- The process of steeping the tea is not as unattended as I would like because once the water heats up and the kettle beeps, it's time to add the tea basket. Then the basket must be removed after steeping has finished to avoid over steeping the tea.

- The basket is narrow and long which causes two issues. First, when using a tea that unfurls (like Pomegranate Oolong from Harney and Sons or Jasmine pearls), the leaves tend to expand upward, leaving part of the leaves unsteeped which results in an uneven brew. Second, removing the leaves from the long infuser basket and cleaning it out is a bit more difficult than with a wider basket that is not so long.

- If I want to have the tea kept warm, I have to remember to set the keep warm function by pressing the tea button again after the brew is done but there's no way to tell that I've already set it. If I forget, the tea gets cold.

- Although it is possible to set custom steeping times, those times are not remembered once the unit is turned off. Also, the particular tea button originally chosen to heat the water has to be pressed once more to start the steeping process and then again and again for each minute increase in time. It is easy to lose count if distracted as there is no LED showing what was requested.

- This tea maker cannot be pre-programmed to start brewing at a certain time, meaning there is no Auto Start Option.

- The carafe lid is hard to dry due to the deep channel in the lid.

This is not a CON for me, but the carafe cannot be submerged in water. This is typical of any tea maker with a heating element attached. I just rinse the carafe or am very careful when washing its interior.

In summary, this tea maker is a "no-frills option" for those who want to brew different teas at various temperatures. It will suit that purpose just fine, especially if the tea is not left to sit in the water for an extended period of time. One can get use to its quirks and the fact that buttons have to be pressed multiple times without any indication of what's been done or any memory of the setting. I do not like that the white and green tea buttons are sort of atypical in the sense that green tea is usually brewed at a higher temperature than white; with this tea maker they have the temperatures reversed. Personally, my favorite is the [[ASIN:B003LNOPSG Breville BTM800XL One-Touch Tea Maker]] and nothing I have ever tried has even comes close to topping that unit. Nevertheless, this Mr. Coffee is acceptable.

This pepper mill needs improvement. This pepper mill is not only for wealthy consumers looking for another way to spend their money. It can be a medical aid in some cases for those with hand problems. I have no objection to a high-priced automatic pepper mill because those who have hand problems (arthritis, carpel tunnel, one arm or hand, etc.) will find it possible to now grind pepper and coriander without difficulty or pain. After all I purchased a $200 [[ASIN:B000A76VCY Breville 800CPXL Die-Cast Stainless-Steel Motorized Citrus Press]] just to reduce the hand stress I was experiencing with squeezing lemons and limes which I absolutely love and believe it was money well spent.

However, this pepper mill is not in the same league. I expected an elite "machine" that worked simply and well and here's what I got.

In the box is one large pepper mill that is mostly all motor. It comes with a small container of peppercorns and what looks like a square base on which the pepper mill should rest when not in use. (NOTE - It slips easily off this base if that is what it was designed for.) There are also 6 AAA batteries included.

The pepper mill has to be disassembled to load the peppercorns and also to extract the motor and load the batteries. Extracting the motor was incredibly cumbersome. There are 2 sliding levers on the inside plate that have to be shifted toward the inside of the motor with a pencil or file. In the process, my levers bent and almost broke off (so they are shoddy levers). Once the levers are no longer holding the motor in place, the unit has to be lightly shaken to dislodge the motor. It took a while for it to dislodge. Once the motor is removed, the batteries were easy to insert and the direction of insertion (negative and positive) were clearly marked.

After battery installation, I had to reverse the entire process. Inserting the motor is tricky as well as I had to line up certain parts, then push down the motor, and re-seat the levers out and under the base lip.

The top of the vessel holding the peppercorns that came with this product also acts also like funnel. I had to unscrew the top and punch out the center piece then lay this over the peppercorn reservoir to fill it. Once that was done. I screwed the holder to the base. (NOTE - Save the container that came with the peppercorns because it is a measuring cup for refilling the reservoir.)

As per the manual, only black, white, and green (dry) peppercorns of 5 mm (0.2") or less should be used in this mill for optimal performance. It also grinds pink peppercorns as long as the pink ones are no more than 15% of the peppercorns being ground. In addition, it grinds dry coriander seeds.

There are six (6) gradations of grind (from fine to coarse) marked on the bottom dial. Based on my tests (since the instructions are not clear on this), it appears the single horizontal line indicates a fine grind and as the lines increase in number to six (6) lines that indicates a coarser grind. The grind level is set by turning the dial to line up the desired grind lines with the letter P written on the reservoir (which is difficult to see).

To dispense the pepper, I just lightly touched the "button" on the top of the base to activate the motor. A light comes on and then dispenses the pepper according to the grind level set. The mill grinds quickly and well. Since the unit engages the motor easily, it means if one of my cats touches the top, the pepper will also grind.

In summary, had I paid for this product, I would have sent it back for a refund. The batteries are too difficult to get to, the levers holding the motor in place are poor quality and easily broken, there is no shutoff for the motor once the batteries are installed so the slightest touch of the button grinds pepper, and it does not feel like the elite "machine" I expected. Also, the lifetime warranty is on the motor only and no other part. If this grinder came with USB or other rechargeable and easy to insert batteries, had the ability to turn off the motor, felt like a quality kitchen tool, and the instructions were clearer (five languages follow each instruction) then I would have given this 5 stars. As it stands now, I consider this a working prototype only and not a kitchen tool that should be sold for such a high price.

Some people will not be able to use this in their car if a grounded power outlet is more than 17 feet away. I am no stranger to carpet cleaners (shampooers). I own a [[ASIN:B0045I8E4M Hoover MaxExtract77 Multi-Surface Pro Carpet & Hard Floor Cleaner FH50240]] and an older version of the [[ASIN:B00450U7QS BISSELL Spotbot Pet Handsfree Spot and Stain Cleaner with Deep Reach Technology, 33N8]]. I also purchased for my boyfriend and have used myself the [[ASIN:B000ASDCWK BISSELL ProHeat 2X Select Upright Deep Carpet Cleaner, 9400M]]. In general, I found Bissell cleaners to be more than satisfactory with the exception of the [[ASIN:B001EYILAW BISSELL PROdry Fast-Drying Carpet Cleaner, 7350]] which I threw out because it was that bad.

For this auto cleaner, I listed the PROS and CONS below and found the unit to be only satisfactory for my purposes.

PROS:

- This can be used for the home or auto.

- Assembly is easy; just attach the hardware (one clip and one arm) for the hose and the brush and you are set.

- It comes with a small bottle of 2x Little Green for Compacts solution.

- The solution has a nice, yet subtle fresh scent.

- The solution tank is easy to fill and the dirty water tank is easy to rinse out. Be careful when inserting the solution tank back into the unit because when I turned the tank over, I held the tank a little too tight which caused the solution to start squirting out. Once I changed my hold to be more subtle and on the upper part of the tank, this squirting ceased.

- The built in heater took only 25 seconds to heat up as opposed to the 30 seconds mentioned in the manual. I also found that the water does come out "warmer" than the other cleaners I have.

- A two-in-one crevice tool is supplied which can be converted with the flip of a switch from a small tiny brush to just a crevice tool that I assume can be used to soak up a puddle of water (although the manual does not say).

- The cord is relatively long for a compact unit which I measured to be around 20 feet; that's about 19-1/2 feet of useable extension. (See the CONS with regard to the cord, which is why I could not use this in my auto.)

- The unit has a quick-release cord wrap which enabled me to unravel the cord easily.

- The solution is easy to dispense and is dispensed out in a fan pattern over the stain. The further away from the surface of the carpet you hold your brush while dispensing the solution the larger the area it covers.

- Although the unit does not pick up as much water as my Spotbot does, I still felt that it picked up enough.

- I thought it spot cleaned my house carpet as well as any of my other cleaners. For my type stains, which are usually cat vomit, that means it lightened the stain. As a result, I suspect it would be great on upholstery and auto interiors such as floor mats, seats, etc. (although I wouldn't use it on the headliner--that's the material on the underside of the roof).

- I was able to clean my removable car floor mat by bringing it into my house for cleaning. It was black in spots and it came out almost spotless although I did use a lot of elbow grease when working the brush over the mat. In fact the dirty water was pitch black when I was done.

- The crevice tool (with the tiny brush) and the small brush that comes with the unit means that this is mostly for spot cleaning; however, with enough back and forth over the affected area, you could clean as much as you wanted.
- Customer service is available Mon to Fri 8 am -10 pm and Saturday 9 a.m. to 8 p.m. Eastern Time.

- I called them twice around 9 p.m. Eastern Time to clarify the WARNINGs in the manual and both reps gave me the same answer which you'll read about in the CONS.

- The unit comes with a 1-year limited warranty.

CONS:

- Only those who have a garage or access to a grounded power outlet within about 17 feet of their car would be able to use this. I said 17 feet because you do need some slack to get into the car even though the hose will extend some. I was unable to clean my car with this because the power cord was not long enough to reach and using an extension cord might cause a severe electrical shock or (as the reps on the phone told me) blow out the circuit breakers in my house. I made sure to call Bissell twice and ask if I could use a cord rated higher than the unit and they said no. I did not ask if this could be used with a jumpstart or other battery pack with an AC connection, although that might be an option, but I would caution you to check first. I live on the 2nd floor and my boyfriend does too, so neither one of us could use this in the car because the WARNING in the manual reads:

WARNING: Do not use an extension cord with the product. The use of an extension cord may result in a severe electrical shock, particularly if the extension cord does not have an electrical rating higher than that of the product, OR if the extension cord does not have a three-prong grounding plug and if the extension cord is not plugged into a circuit box with a ground fault circuit interrupter. Safety precautions such as keeping all connections off the ground and dry will not eliminate the danger.

- I do not like that I can only use the Bissell 2x Little Green for Compacts formula in this unit. This means I cannot use any other Bissell cleaning products in this unit and I called customer service to verify this. The WARNING in the manual reads:

WARNING: Use only BISSELL Little Green formula in your cleaner. Use of cleaning formulas which contain lemon or pine oil may damage this appliance and void the warranty. Chemical spot cleaners or solvent-based soil removers also should not be used. These products may react with the plastic materials used in your cleaner, causing cracking or pitting.

- The user instructions are not so good. For instance, nowhere does it mention that both the built in heater and the unit has to be in the on position to heat up the water; although that is intuitive. Also, the manual should say you should vacuum first before using. I already know this but not everyone would.

- A bit of water stays behind in the channel below the dirty water tank and in the tough stain tool which is expected; however, be careful if moving this around or transporting to another location because if the unit tilts the dirty water that remains in the channel might spill out.

In summary, I selected this product so that I could clean the attached carpet in my auto and the cloth seats in my boyfriend's auto, but was unable to do that due to the extension cord restriction. However, I still feel this is a satisfactory carpet cleaner / shampooer that can be used to spot clean carpet or upholstery in my home or the removable dirty floor mats that I can bring in from the car. As long as one has access to an outlet close to their car, based on the results in my home and on my removable vehicle floor mats I have no doubt this would work on cloth car seats and the non-removable auto carpet. I do wish I could use another Bissell cleaning solution (such as the pet solution) besides the one that came with the unit; but that did not take away from the cleaning power; it just takes away from the options. In essence this unit has only one cleaning option, the Bissell 2x Little Green for Compacts formula.

I feel this unit was 2.5 stars because of the limited options and rounded up to give it 3 stars. If the first two CONS were addressed, then I probably would have rated this four stars as it does clean as well as the three other units (including the Hoover) that I listed in my introduction. Nevertheless, as a potential buyer, only you can try to determine based on the the various posted reviews if this unit is right for you.

Received a Pan Damaged Prior to Shipment. I was excited to try this 13”x9” baking pan as all of the ones I have are glass and often are more difficult to clean and maintain. A metal non-stick pan would be great! Unfortunately, the one I received was damaged. Worse, it is clear it was damaged even before it went into the packing box.

This is a nice, heavy pan that has a good non-stick finish on it. It doesn’t appear to be Teflon which is good. It should work well for things like casseroles, cakes and other recipes that call for this size baking dish.

Right out of the box, my pan was dented up. All four corners have been dented enough to be obvious in both sight and touch. The box in which it shipped was completely fine, though, which tells me that it went into the box already damaged before it was sealed and shipped. The damage was consistent with being dropped at an odd angle and under load, or having been inverted and having heave things stacked on top of it. I do not know if this occurred where it was manufactured or if instead it happened prior to retail shipment. Lack of scratch marks on the finish suggests the former.

I think I can pound it back into shape with a mallet and wooden dowel, but that’s not an acceptable solution. I should be clear, it does not impact usability, but it’s enough to impact the shape of some things baked in the pan.

I really wanted to like this pan but receiving an item that is damaged (and was likely damaged where it was manufactured) is a serious problem. I hope I am the only one who had this issue, but I cannot rate it higher based on a hope or an assumption. It’s a shame; it’s otherwise a nice baking pan.

That’s fine, there’s a use for something like that and if that’s the intended use it’ll be fine. If you want it for a double, queen or king-sized bed, it won’t cover the whole bed, and even that can be ok if you just want coverage for one.

Relatively strong water flosser but reservoir is attached which makes drying it nearly impossible. I have used various countertop water flossers in the past such as the countertop WaterPik and the [[ASIN:B07HRNGS3Q Truwell Handheld Water Flosser]]. I love the idea of a hand held irrigator and this does work to remove most stuck debris from between the teeth. What is nice about this one over the other handheld I tried, is that there is very little splash back. However, I personally do not like that the reservoir is not removable for drying.

IN THE PACKAGE
- One reservoir attached to handheld flosser unit
- One USB cable (wall adapter NOT included)
- One instruction manual
- One standard jet nozzle
- One orthodontic nozzle (larger brush)
- One pocket nozzle (smaller brush)
- One tong scraping nozzle (what looks like a spoon)

I charged the unit fully before use. The white light on the side blinks when charging and remains steady when it is fully charged. Note the charging port is hidden behind a silicone nub below the grip dots on the top of the unit. Be careful to cover the charging port with this nub when the flosser is in use.

There is an on/off switch and a mode switch. The three water pressure modes are soft, standard, and massage can be cycled through using the mode switch prior to turning the unit on. The jet tip (or any of the other three tips) gets inserted into the top. Be careful to make sure it is seated with the notch in the groove as the first time I put it in the hole, I did not have it seated all the way. To eject, press the release button to the left side.

This is a gommage. It is meant to clump/form bits. Apply to dry face, massage, rinse. SOFTNESS!. This is a gommage!!! The most gentle of all the physical exfoliation out there. If you haven't tried it, I highly recommend. I also highly recommend anything by Easydew. Good stuff! Know that this is meant to clump! Not supposed to have lather or creaminess. I had looked at the ingredients and some of the description and I suspected a gommage. The directions on box say to use on wet face and that it will lather. It doesn't. There is some clumps, but not as much as if it were used on a dry face, which is what is expected from a gommage. We want glorious clumps! For best results use on a clean dry face, not a wet face. I have tried it both ways, definitely use on dry face. Works but not as good on wet face.

So use a generous amount. Just pat it in all over. Let it sit a moment, then massage it in in gentle circular motion. As you do so, small clumps will form. This is a combination of product and grime and dead skin cells. Basically, a "gommage" is like an eraser on a pencil, and your skin is paper. The graphite marks are dirt and dead skin cells. The product once applied is like that eraser-- it is removing those "marks". What happens when you use an erase? You start to see balled up pieces of eraser mixed with the graphite/pencil marks. That is more or less what is happening here. Those balled up pieces are a mix of product, dirt, and cells. Rinse, and carry on with rest of your routine. It is a very gentle "peel". Make sure you follow the instruction, clean your face, apply an even layer and let it sit for about 15 to 20 minutes. I let it get pretty dry before I rinsed it off with lukewarm water. My skin felt great and was nice and soft after I used this mask. I for one can only recommend this one.

Nice product, seems to work well. This is a nice serum by Easydew that comes in a dropper bottle. In it is a DW-EGF protein. It is basically a youth protein that helps your skin with collagen and elastin, basically helps your skin stay soft, smooth, and just look great.

This serum is a light to medium consistency that absorbs quickly into the skin. It doesn't leave any kind of residue on the skin, it is maybe a bit tacky at first but that goes away quickly. I am not prone to reactions to these kinds of products and didn't have any in this case either.

I found this was a great moisturizer and my skin looked soft and smooth overall. This is a nice product and I am satisfied overall. It is also reasonably priced at just $30.

Great gift set. This is a fantastic pack of 12 face masks. You get 2 beauty boosters, 2 best self forward, 2 fresh start, 2 girl’s night in, 2 character face masks and 2 sit back & relax masks. Each has some different ingredients but you will find something that fits what your face is in need of from soothing and calming to helping with inflammation to moisturizing and more. The masks have mild yet pleasant fragrances. The masks themselves are soft and fit very well. This gift set is just $16 so just over a $1 a mask, a great deal really.

Works as promised. I have another blackhead remover but that one did not have the camera adapter. I wanted to actually see the details so this one seemed cool so why not? It is very easy to use and I have to say seeing on the phone what was happening was neat. The blackhead remove is very easy to use, similar to the one I already have really. It has different sized heads that allow you to change the pressure that you are applying. The power button turns it on and off but also changes the modes from soft to normal to strong.

Make sure you keep it moving or the vacuum can actually cause damage, meaning break some capillaries which will cause a bruise. This will obviously heal but who wants a bruise in the face?

I really like this because you can really see what is going on up close. It is easy to use and works well. The price is reasonable and the pairing with the phone (Samsung S20+) worked well.

Works very well. This is a neat little curling iron that does the work for you really. I have tried some different types of curling irons over the year and wanted something easy and simple to use. My hair is quite long these days and when you have longer hair it gets a little bit more complicated I found. So I wanted to give this one a chance and see how it goes. There is definitely a slight learning curve but watch the video and off you go.

The temperature adjustment is at the handle and is very easy to use by rotating it. The tip is insulated so you can actually touch it which is a nice added touch in my eyes. There is also an adjustment that lets you switch if it turns left or right when making the curls so you can switch that as well depending on which way you want your curls to go. It comes with 3 different barrels that lets you change the type of curls you get.

I found it works quite well and is easy to use. I had no issues with my long hair because it has the long barrel to accommodate all my hair and actually curl it all. All in all I am quite happy with this.

Interesting cream that starts of like a butter then liquifies with your body heat. This facial cream comes in a beautiful frosted glass jar. When you open the jar, the cream inside of it is not one of those lotion types but more a butter type of cream, very solid and almost waxy. Don’t be alarmed it did not go rancid or bad, that is just how this cream is. You will scoop some of it out and will notice it actually smells pretty good. With the heat of your skin it also starts to liquify somewhat and makes it easier to apply to your skin.

At this point it absorbs pretty easily and quickly into the skin. There were no issues there at all. I for one really liked this cream and it absorbs fully without leaving any residue behind on the skin. The skin actually feels soft and smooth and smells great, sadly only for a few minutes though since the fragrance does fade fairly quickly, but the softness stays. My skin felt moisturized and was rather happy. All in all this is a great little find.

Cute set of lipsticks, makes a great gift too. This set of lipsticks is such a gimmick but man I really like them. They are meant to look like a box of cigarettes and the 4 lipsticks are actually pretty small, also meant to look like little cigarettes. This set of 4 will run you about $10 which is not a bad deal to be honest.

The little bullet style lipsticks all have very similar tones to be honest but are just different enough that you can distinguish them. They are very easy to apply and you can get a nice pointy application with them which is great. They are surprisingly smooth and creamy and have a good taste to them. They have a pretty good staying power, again it was a bit surprising to be honest. They wear not bad in the waterproof department but did wear off a bit on cups and mugs.

All in all I was impressed by these and think these would make for a great little gag gift, especially for young adults dabbling into makeup but also for others as well that are looking for a lipstick that goes well into the purse and gives them options.

Lovely moisturizer for wrinkles. This FillUp by EasyDew is a great cream that I personally really like a lot. First of it comes in a stunning squeeze tube that has a one of those interesting tips for a more concentrated spot application. This pretty silver tube will look great on any bathroom shelf really. It is meant for spot treatment for wrinkles and contains hyaluronic acid to help with that with lots of moisture to be added to the skin but other ingredients as well to help with all of that.

This cream has a very nice but mild fragrance that I do like. The cream is very lightweight. That tip allows precise spot application to where you want and need to put it and allows small application of the product. It absorbs very quickly into the skin and leaves no residue behind. I found that my skin is soft and smooth when I use this. It looks great, moisturized and just overall great. It is also not very expensive less than $25 so for me this one is a winner.

Very nice moisturizer. his is a nice moisturizer for men but in my eyes could also be used for women. It is pretty much fragrance free which makes it great for people who are sensitive to fragrances. It comes in a very classic black squeeze tube. This moisturizer is very lightweight and absorbs quickly into the skin. There is no residue left behind on the skin either which is great. The skin feels nicely moisturized which is exactly as it should. This is also not an expensive product which makes it perfect.

Love it, oriental scent that is very similar to LouLou. This is a very nice perfume. It is not too expensive since it is less than $40 which is great. When I got it and sprayed it on I had instant flashbacks of another perfume that I really like. It is very reminiscent of LouLou and when I looked up the fragrance profile for both there is a lot of overlap of the similar top, heart and base notes.

I found that this one in comparison is a bit less heavy though and not as overpowering. It has a very oriental kind of scent though and I do really like it, ask LouLou, since it is standing right next to it on my perfume shelf. I figured that was the proper space for it. This one does have a hint of lightness though that LouLou does not. It does last quite a bit and does not just disappear after a few hours which is nice.

The bottle is very cute and oh so Shakira in my eyes. It is perfect for teens if you ask me but I have no problem putting that on my shelf either. So to keep the comparison going, at the same volume it is cheaper than LouLou but if you get the 2.7 Fl Oz you pay the same price as you would for the 1.7 Fl Oz for LouLou so you could get a better deal but even though they are similar there are just different enough that I can smell the difference if I do a blind test.

Incredible set of stunning lipsticks!. I just love these Sigma Lipsticks! In this set you get 4 unique lipsticks that are all in the same color family but the colors are different enough that you actually get 4 different lipsticks and it is worth getting this set for a whopping $75! The colors are 2 beautiful earthy nudes, one more pinky nude and one stunning red tone that is just plain perfect! This is a gorgeous set in regards to colors.

Now the applicators are so unique and different and stunning on their own. They also have a magnetic closure of sorts because when you close them they kind of pull shut at the very end so they must have a magnetic closure in it.

The lipstick themselves are super creamy and feel amazing on the lips. They have a pleasant taste to them and are just amazing. There is nothing but greatness about them and these are worthy of the name Sigma! I love everything about these and can only recommend this set. Perfect to give as a gift or purchase and breakup and give individual ones as a gift since each are packaged in a box.

Very nice palette that is easy to use, maybe a tad on the expensive side. This is a very nice eye shadow palette. In it you get 2 cool brown shades that are mattes and one shimmer and one glitter shade. They are very nice colors and all go very well together so you really don't have to think hard to get a look that looks fantastic with this 4 color palette. The mattes blend easily and look great. Even a beginner should have no issue with these. I used them with and without a primer and they had fantastic staying power so no complaints there either.

The shimmer and glitter were fantastic to make the look standout. Either one works for whatever occasion you have in mind, shimmer for day to day wear and glitter for a more evening wear in my eyes.

At almost $30 for 4 colors this is a bit more on the expensive side since I have gotten some fantastic inexpensive palettes for less with a lot more colors but this is a very nice palette and great for travel really.

Incredible lightweight product that makes my skin feel amazing!. I wasn't sure what to expect but I am a REAL fan of this deep emulsion. It comes in a cute little bottle that has a little pump dispenser on the top. The emulsion smells incredible and is one of my favorites really. It is super lightweight and feels very cooling when you use it so I really like to use this one when I saw a lot of sun during the day because it just feels fantastic and on top of that also smells great.

The emulsion absorbs very quickly into your skin and your skin feels amazingly soft. I found my skin looked great as well so this one in my eyes really ticked all the boxes. I felt there was no residue left on my skin either. I for one am a fan and can only recommend this one and the price is not bad at all at less than $30. I might have to check into more of their products. Thankfully it came with lots of samples that I will try and probably end up getting more, oh the hardship.

Not a fan of this soap. Sadly I do not care for this True-Aloe cleansing bar. It is a fairly large soap bar I give it that, however I don't care for how it smells at all. The scent of this soap bar is actually sort of off putting to be honest, which is odd considering the ingredients that it has. Also it is kind of weird that it has these weird little bumbs in it, not sure what they are. My skin felt pretty dry when I used it as well so all in all I am not a fan of this.

Read the description carefull, says it is actually for fungus and will make your nails fall off. Beware, this is a product that is meant for nails with toe fungus and to completely remove those nails and start fresh!

They make it sound like it is to strengthen nails that may need some help but once you read the instructions on the box it actually tells you when you use this product that your nail will fall off.

It smells pretty horrific. So unless you have severe nail fungus and want your nails to fall off, don't use this. I haven't tried it since that is not what I wanted. When I got this I read the "renews, restores and dehydrates damaged nails, repairs and protects" not makes your nails fall of. So with that being said, I will have to pass actually using this product.

Incredible sheet mask that makes your face really happy. This is a very nice sheet face mask. It is very easy to use, basically a sheet mask that you put over your face. I like the fact that it comes in two pieces so you really can make it fit perfectly to your face. The one pieces are just one fits all kind of masks and lets face it, not all faces are the same scie or shape and therefore they just don't all fit. With this one you have a lot of nice wriggle room which is great.

It is very easy to put on. Once it is on you let it sit for about 15 to 20 minutes (btw, if you go longer you get more of the goodies). So just have a good show on tv or a book handy to read. I did notice that it is fairly heavy though but it amazingly did not slip on me but I was afraid that it may.

This mask smells beautifully of roses and for once not overpowering of it. I am not the biggest fan of the smell of roses but this one was pleasant since it was not this cloying smell of it. This is a collagen mask and when you remove it you can tell how soft your face is. I really liked this mask but it is on the more expensive side. You get 4 masks in the box for $25, so each is about $6, so that is a bit on the higher end of sheet masks but they are very nice.

Not a bad facial serum but does make your face somewhat tacky. This is an interesting serum for your face. The bottle comes in this interesting dropper bottle that only shows the dropper when you unscrew the cap. The serum is a milky kind of solution, so make sure you mix it well before you use it just to make sure it is well mixed.

The serum is kind of thick but absorbs quickly into your skin. Your skin stays tacky for about an hour or so. After that it becomes fairly nice and soft.

The serum does have a scent to it but I can't describe it. It is fairly nice though so no complaints there. I have had no negative skin reactions or issues when I used this product. This to me is a little over average.

Not bad but not the greatest either. You get a lot of hyaluronic acid serum in this bottle. It is pretty much scent less for those who prefer that this one is perfect in that regards. I have been looking for something like these for some time and this is the perfect set. I wish they would have just made all in darker colors so they don't show the makeup stains at all but it is ok the way it is and I can work with it. Fantastic buy of a high quality product!

I didn't think it really added that much volume to my lashes as much as it actually lengthened them which is fine. The wand is a nice thin wand that helps not making a mess all over. The bristles are shorter and make it very easy to use. The mascara is smudge proof. I had it on for a solid 16 hours and it did not budge until I used a makeup remover and it came off very easy at that point.

Very nice moisturizine cream. This hydrating cream by Sustainable Youth is one of their better products in my eyes. This heavier cream actually leaves behind very soft skin that looks good. I liked how my skin felt. The scent of it does dissipate fairly quickly though but that is ok. All in all this is probably my favorite product in their line. Would I repurchase, probably not because their are products out there as good and better for a similar price or cheaper. The bag is gorgeous but don't bother with the brushes. This is a very cute makeup bag. The coloring of it is just gorgeous and the main reason I got it really. The material is super soft. Fantastic lip balm. This set of lip balm is very nice. It applies easily and leaves your lips feeling nice and soft without feeling greasy or tacky. They taste of tangerine which is great. Halloween Or Messing Around Okay, But Serious Wear, Not So Much. I have been working with wigs for quite a few years now. One thing I know is a good quality vs not so great quality wig. Let's take a look at this one.

WHAT IS THIS LIKE?

HAIR
This wig has some great hair. the colors are definitely platinum white and what I would call light auburn base hairs. The white hairs are about 1/3 or so longer than the auburn hairs. There is a nice kink to the hairs.

THICKNESS
That is where this wig is sadly lacking. At the top, the wefts of hair are way too far apart. The lace in the cap is a very light butter colored yellow. The hair is not too thin, but it is not quite thick enough to cover hair below. Yes, this comes with a nylon cap, but it just is not comfortable with those. If you have dark hair it will definitely show the bright colored lace and elastics through the wig when the wind blows.

BANGS/STYLE
That is where this wig is just not practical unless you don't mind looking stupid for a party or Halloween. The bangs are WAY too long for anyone to wear. That usually would not be a problem, but what you will get instead of the cool light ends on the entire head is chopped bang that is bland looking and then these white cool looking ends around the head. The bangs are best cut painstakingly so that the auburn is cut way shorter (about 2/3) than the white hairs. That takes a lot of time but worth the effort. Then you have to cut them at a staggered manner.

Other than the bangs being hard to trim so you can at least function with this wig on, the overall style is fabulous. I love how it falls and looks while on the head.

ELASTIC BANDS
Inside the wig, there are elastic bands with hooks to help hold the wig on the head. You might want to take them down to the spot you like it in as the hooks have a tendency to come undone during wearing.

WHAT I WANT IN A WIG
Believe it or not, I would actually wear a wig like this with the right outfit, and not to be silly either. I prefer wigs that look authentic,, and can be worn realistically as well as for fun.

1. I have to be able to see out of it
2. I have to be able to wear it comfortably without fussing
3. I want it to not have my real hair showing
4. I want it to look realistic
5. I want it to last for quite a few wearings

DOES THIS WIG PASS THE TEST?
I am giving this wig THREE stars because it is hard to wear and see. In order to trim this in a realistic manner, I have to take a LOT of time and that takes stars off for me. I happen to love the style and coloring, so I am wiling to put the work into it, but honestly, I think it should be a bit shorter in the bangs area since it is so hard to trim and keep it looking real. Also, the wefting on the top is just a bit too widely spaced. I wish also that the cap was made with light auburn lace and elastic instead of the icy yellow colors.

THE BOTTOM LINE
If you want to wear this for fun, it will be hard to see and hard to trim and not look silly in this. It is comfortable and the style is epic, but there will be work required. You can bandana it to help, but it still will look a bit floppy unless trimmed a little bit in the bangs/fringe area. I like this, but it takes work to wear and not look silly for me.

MY RATING
THREE STARS. The trimming of the bangs is VERY time consuming since we only have one shot at it and if it is screwed up, then the wig is toast. I wish there was more hair on top and that the lace cap did not show as easily. A darker cap underneath (light auburn color) would have been much nicer with this. I will still use this, but it could have been a bit nicer with small inexpensive changes.

Removes Regular (Not Gel) Tough Polish Well, Does Not Leave Nails Parched. When it comes to nail polish remover, I have two choices. I use either the store brand, or professional brand, which is often pure acetone used in tough removal like gel polish. Let's look at this one.

WHAT TYPE OF POLISH?
I had on a very dark red polish which was wearing very intensely for a week. Removal with some removers would leave red stains everywhere.

WHAT IS THIS LIKE?
This polish remover comes in the same type of bottle most store brands do. There is no special scent and it is typical remover.

HOW DID THIS PERFORM?
This polish remover took off the red polish with no problem, left no red staining, and did not leave my nails completely parched like some harsher ones might.

THE BOTTOM LINE
This polish removes regular nail polish (not talking about gel here) very well. It does not leave nails too stripped.

MY RATING
Five stars. It does what it is supposed to to without excessive problems or smells.

Nice grooming set. My husband used this kit and took, when asked to do a bit of a review on it for me, took it very seriously. The price isn't cheap so he wanted to make sure to really look at everything as he used it. Here is what he had to say:

"You have a pack of accessories here so I thought I would run through them in turn to tell you what you are getting and my impression of it

Shampoo and body wash.
Okay, I ran through this way too quick and used all of it. It's good. It's really good and I couldn't really get enough of it. So that's a plus and a negative in that there isn't really a lot of it to begin with.

Face wash.
I love to get In there and give my face a right good scrubbing. This helps. The wash is thick and gel like with the exfoliating, and it does feel like you have given your face a good scrub after use. You do feel cleaner after use.

Shave cream
I'm not one for using cream very often. I prefer basic foam from a can. But wow. This stuff leaves your face feeling clean and fresh after shaving. Not only that but incredibly soft.

Moisture cream
This is really not something I use at all. I would think it best to use after shaving because you are stripping moisture from your face, but in that regard the shave cream is sufficient. I just don't personally have a need for a separate moisture cream. So it is sort of hard to form an opinion about it.
What I can tell you is that it doesn't really have a scent, my face does feel super soft. On the downside it is a little messy and I found myself wiping away the excess.

For the most part then I really like this set. It comes in a handy pouch you can use long after the accessories are empty. However, that won't take too long because the bottles are very small. It's something for people who aren't concerned about the cost. It's very expensive. Is it worth the cost for me? Not really. Not in terms of either quality or quantity but if the price was lower I would be recommending to everyone."

There you go guys and gals. That's what he thought about the set. He's still talking about it so he did like it, just thought it was a bit much.

Desktop Pro 2019 works great; upgrading an existing payroll subscription is awful. Desktop Pro 2019 upgraded smoothly and easily with absolutely no issues. I began by backing up my QuickBooks desktop Pro 2018, and then began the installation process. It went smoothly and quickly and didn't take very long. I used the express installation which was recommended, and the whole thing was very easily done, retaining all of my previous settings and information.

The part that was awful was that I have an existing payroll subscription and had to call into tech-support to upgrade that portion of things. Luckily I was aware of this so when simply entering the information into QuickBooks didn't work, I knew that I was in for a phone call. About 45 minutes later of being on hold and trying to be up sold on QuickBooks online by an Indian tech-support person (hey guys, I just got desktop Pro 2019 upgraded, please don't sell me on QuickBooks online), I was good to go.

I think it's absolutely offensive that after you've purchased a software product like this they make you call in as a matter of course to activate. Anybody using this product is either being paid by the hour or runs a business and does not have that kind of spare time to sit around wasting on a process that should be 30 seconds of data entry.

I have multiple employees and so end up paying an additional 4 to 8 dollars per month for the subscription to add additional employees. It's another two dollars a month per employee after the first one. Also, be aware that the setting is set to subscribe you to an annual payroll subscription, which if done through QuickBooks will cost you about $420. Purchasing the new upgrade of desktop Pro 2019 with the payroll for a year costs less than that, so being automatically billed such a high amount for just the payroll is offensive and ridiculous.

I would really like QuickBooks as a company to reconsider how they deal with their payroll subscriptions and activation of payroll that has already been purchased, because this is a huge problem that is been garnering them poor reviews and lots of bad press for some time. I personally have considered many times changing to a more congenial company just to avoid this particular dance every single year. Do I pay $420 to avoid being on the phone for 45 minutes with somebody from India who act like I've done something terribly wrong by purchasing my payroll upgrade on Amazon along with the software upgrade? Or do I do as I have done most years and purchase the yearly upgrade that comes with the enhanced payroll.

As an FYI, the enhanced payroll really does make it very easy to run your quarterly reports and do your e-filing. I did it myself for many years, but now hand the file back and forth to my bookkeeper via email as a portable file.
